verdict.rationale: Apple's own newsroom directly claims M4 Pro pairs strong performance with 'legendary power efficiency' for professionals working on video and large files. That is only a thin marketing statement, and battery-life figures do not establish sustained render throughput. Missing for 10: documented power envelopes or wattage figures, evidence of sustained or no-throttling behavior under long renders and exports, and independent testing of sustained performance per watt.

support.subject: As a creator, long renders and exports don't throttle away — documented power envelopes and independent testing showing strong sustained performance per watt

citations.quote: For professionals working on larger file sizes across AI, video, code bases, and more, M4 Pro offers stunning performance and Apple silicon’s legendary power efficiency.
